author: sjm41
body:
Hi @RLovering 

We are proposing to obsolete 'GO:1903195 regulation of L-dopa biosynthetic process' and its two children - see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31703

There is a single EXP annotation from ParkinsonsUK-UCL:
PARK7 Parkinson disease protein 7 ParkinsonsUK-UCL Homo sapiens IMP PMID:16731528
[positive regulation of L-dopa biosynthetic process](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:1903197)

But abstract of PMID:16731528 says "inactivation of DJ-1 (PARK7) by small interference RNA (siRNA) results in decreased TH expression and l-DOPA production in human dopaminergic cell lines....Therefore, our results...directly link the loss of DJ-1 expression and transcriptional dysfunction to impaired **dopamine** synthesis."

So I think this annotation should be changed to 'GO:1903181 positive regulation of dopamine biosynthetic process'.
Can you do that?
Thanks.
